source_commit_message: ci: harden PR Agent as advisory review (#197)
observations: Accepted main did not contain an indexed revision doctor command at bootstrap.
The checked-in roadmap status snapshot trails the observed main and must be treated as historical evidence rather than rewritten blindly.
M6 research work is present in open pull requests but is not production authority until merged and qualified.
Existing Station and GoalSpec machinery can host bounded self-improvement without creating a second implementation authority.
bootstrap_actions: Add strict ImprovementCandidate validation and frozen-evaluator overlap rejection.
Block bootstrap autonomous writes to protected trust-boundary paths.
Delegate execution to a Station-managed clone and export only after successful controlled integration.
Add an intentionally low-risk first candidate and regression tests.
nonclaims: This record is not evidence that an autonomous generation completed successfully.
Open M6 research pull requests are not treated as accepted main capability.
A Station export is not equivalent to production merge or production qualification.
evidence_note: GitHub compare confirms the recorded roadmap main is an ancestor of observed main, 8 commits behind and 0 commits ahead. This is roadmap/status lag, not history divergence and not implicit qualification of the later commits.
implemented_controls: Content-addressed Revision Doctor binds roadmap, current status, M7 mission policy, and Factory ownership baseline bytes.
Two independent Station scout tasks feed one dependent candidate composer.
Generated proposals have proposal authority only and are retained as Station artifacts before deterministic admission.
Candidate writable scopes may not overlap and generation-wide frozen evaluator files cannot be writable.
Executable-code candidates declare frozen tests/test_*.py evaluators; the Mission Governor derives pytest commands and rejects all model-authored executable checks.
Factory ownership-manifest paths plus M7/Station/verifier/governance surfaces are blocked from autonomous writes.
Every managed Station clone is checked against the doctor-certified source HEAD before execution.
Cycle execution revalidates source HEAD, source report identity, and mission plan identity after origination.
Production merge remains external governed authority.
No-op successful batches are not exported as successors; accepted generations must change the Git tree.
Bounded experimental lineage can feed an accepted Station successor into the next generation without modifying the original checkout.
The initiating M7 governor implementation remains frozen for an experimental lineage even if candidate source edits the future controller.
The entire tests/ tree plus pytest/import-control surfaces are protected from autonomous writes, preventing one lineage generation from weakening a later generation's evaluator.
Governor-derived pytest starts under Python isolated mode with third-party plugin autoload disabled before the candidate repository is added to the evaluator path.
Autonomous execution blocks when the source revision is behind or diverged from the repository's known main revision.
Without explicit command-check permission, origination is constrained to non-executable documentation/data candidates and executable proposals fail before Station execution.
Revision Doctor identity additionally binds the M7 controller and M7 safety regression bytes.
